exposure: Endometrial preparation protocol (programmed FET vs. true natural cycle FET)
BMI (Group A: 18.5-23.99 kg/m², Group B: 24-27.99 kg/m², Group C: ≥28 kg/m²)
true natural cycle frozen embryo transfer
cohort: 2333 women who underwent singleton frozen-thawed embryo transfer
finding: Programmed FET was associated with a higher risk of pregnancy-induced hypertension compared to true natural cycle FET, particularly in women with a BMI ≥ 28 kg/m².
mod_finding: This study on frozen-thawed embryo transfer did not examine mode of delivery.
